root_cause_detail: ME model generates ~1GB of Stan CSV files in /tmp (9000 tau + 9000 log_lik params x 4 chains x 1000 samples = ~114MB/chain). Combined with other /tmp usage, the 3.9GB tmpfs limit was exceeded when the simple model tried to write its own CSVs. All 4 chains returned retcode=1 due to disk write failure, not numerical issues.

test2_sigma03_with_inits.note: Chains 1-4 completed sampling successfully, crashed during summary extraction due to /tmp disk quota exceeded

test3_sigma01_with_inits.note: Python parent process timed out; chains ran as orphans and completed. Results extracted via manual stansummary.

me_model_sigma01.root_cause: 10231 parameters (9000 tau latent vars) vs 9000 binary observations. Model severely under-identified. tau prior std_normal() conflicts with true distribution (mostly zero).

simple_model_sigma01.root_cause: Disk quota exceeded. ME model CSVs (~1GB) consumed available /tmp space before simple model started.

exp006_simple_model.note: Bounds difference is cosmetic, not the cause of crashes

recommendations.fix_disk_issue: Clean /tmp before running, or set CmdStanPy output_dir to a non-tmpfs location with more space
recommendations.fix_me_model: Replace contam_irt_4pl_me.stan with contam_irt_4pl_me_analytic.stan (eliminates 9000 tau latent variables, same parameter count as simple model)
recommendations.run_order: Run simple model BEFORE ME model to avoid ME model's large CSV files filling disk
recommendations.sigma_e_range: Both σ_e=0.1 and σ_e=0.3 converge fine. No need to drop σ_e=0.1.
recommendations.provide_inits: Recommended but not strictly necessary (σ_e=0.3 converged without inits)
